_note: Value-semantics fixture (#153, #156). §2 mandates YAML 1.2, in which yes/no/on/off are STRINGS, not booleans — and the JSON schema types these fields as boolean, so such a value is a schema violation. All three parsers must therefore read the 1.1 words as UNDECLARED, exactly as they read a typo. Only true/false are booleans.
